long_biography.plain_text:
Corporate transactions have been the organising subject of Morrison's communications career. At Financial Dynamics, he helped grow a leading agency before co-founding the specialist crisis consultancy Keyhaven. His work has ranged across investor relations, public affairs, capital raising and complex international reputation assignments.

In 2014, Morrison conceived Montfort as a modern communications group and assembled a senior team around that model. The firm expanded into litigation, digital campaigning, geopolitical advice and multi-market communications. He holds a majority of its shares and voting rights and continues as founding partner, retaining direct ownership of the advisory business.
